content.text: In countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Zimbabwe, digital creators face a stark reality: platforms like Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are either unavailable or impose crippling restrictions. This breakdown explains the architecture, the tools, and the deployment steps to build a system where you control [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-selling-music-online-6|everything]]. No workarounds. Just infrastructure.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

Bitcoin payments for digital downloads are not a hack—they’re a base-layer infrastructure shift. Instead of renting access to platforms like Gumroad (which charges 10% per sale), you deploy a stack where buyers pay in crypto, and the product delivers automatically. The core value? Sovereignty. You own the hosting, the backend logic, and the payment verification. No platform can shut you down, no fees erode your margins, and no buyer data leaves your control. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, switching from Gumroad to NOWPayments (0.5% fee) retains $921 more in revenue. This isn’t about avoiding fees—it’s about building infrastructure you own.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The system operates on four layers: hosting, backend logic, payment verification, and file delivery. Hosting uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages (free). Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script (free), which handles order processing and file delivery. Payment verification uses NOWPayments, which confirms on-chain crypto transactions and fires a webhook to trigger delivery. Files are stored on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 (free). When a buyer sends crypto, NOWPayments verifies the payment, the backend script checks the webhook, and the file is delivered instantly. No manual intervention. No platform dependency. Full automation.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is built for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are restricted or unreliable. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, or software and cannot use Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad, this system gives you a fully operational store. It’s also for creators who reject platform fees and data ownership compromises. Whether you’re in Kenya, Pakistan, or Venezuela, the stack works the same. It’s pressure-tested in Zimbabwe—a market where currency collapse and payment rejection are the norm. If it works there, it works anywhere.
At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, switching from Gumroad to NOWPayments retains $921 more in revenue.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component is chosen for its reliability, cost, and sovereignty. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your storefront (free). Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic (free). Supabase or Google Sheets store order data (free). NOWPayments verifies crypto payments (0.5% fee). Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files (free). The stack is modular—you can swap components as needed. For example, use BSC, Solana, or TRON networks for transaction fees under $0.10. The system is designed to be lightweight, fast, and fully owned by you. No subscriptions. No platform lock-in.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing a stack: Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) for GitHub Pages + Apps Script or Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase. Both deploy in 48 hours with products pre-loaded. If you prefer to build yourself, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates—everything you need to deploy and scale. Each stack comes with 30-day support and end-to-end testing. Once deployed, you own the infrastructure. No COREMERCH access. No platform dependence. Just a system that works, anywhere.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, deploy a sovereign stack using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. This architecture bypasses platform restrictions and fees. For example, selling a $97 ebook 100 times per month retains $921 more revenue compared to Gumroad’s 10% fee. The system is automated, secure, and fully owned by you. Start with the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or build from scratch using the Complete Builder Kit ($197).
The system is pressure-tested in Zimbabwe—if it works there, it works anywhere.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re selling notion templates for USDT or Bitcoin, or looking to build a digital download store without platform fees, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates to deploy a sovereign stack. Available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, it’s everything you need to own your infrastructure. Whether you’re in the Philippines, Tanzania, or Cameroon, this system works where Stripe and PayPal fail. No workarounds. Just architecture.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for pre-built deployment, or the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for DIY. 2. Set up hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 3. Configure backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 4. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. 5. Store order data in Supabase or Google Sheets. 6. Upload files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 7. Test end-to-end: simulate a purchase to ensure file delivery. 8. Deploy and own your infrastructure. No platform dependence. No fees. Just sovereignty.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this system if I’m not technical?

Yes. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) are deployed for you in 48 hours. If you prefer to build, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes step-by-step blueprints and templates.
What cryptocurrencies can buyers use?

NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON—all under $0.10 per transaction. Buyers pay in USD, converted to crypto at transaction time.
Do I need to set up a buyer account?
No. Buyers pay directly from their crypto wallets. No accounts, no KYC. The system verifies payments on-chain and delivers files automatically.
What happens if a payment fails?
If a payment fails, the file is not delivered. The system only triggers delivery once NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain. No manual intervention required.
Can I scale this system as my sales grow?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for email deliverability. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes a scaling playbook for high-volume deployments.
You own the infrastructure. No platform access. No subscriptions. Just sovereignty.
